name: ga4gh-tes skill
summary: Submit, monitor, and cancel batch compute tasks on a configured GA4GH Task Execution Service (TES) server, and read the server's own description
description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Task Execution Service (TES), shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-tes` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Submit, monitor, and cancel batch compute tasks on a configured GA4GH Task Execution Service (TES) server, and read the server's own description. Use when the user asks about GA4GH TES compute tasks, wants to run a container-based task on a TES server, needs to check or cancel task status, or needs the TES server's service-info.
